_comment: Combat sound effects (docs/PLAN-combat-sounds.md). tools/gen-sfx.mjs generates any missing assets/sfx/<key>.mp3 from these descriptions with ElevenLabs, loudness-normalises it, and rewrites module/sfx-manifest.mjs. Delete a file to regenerate it. One sound per class and cadence, never per weapon.

firearm-single: A single gunshot from a modern handgun, sharp crack with a short echo in a city street, no other sounds
firearm-burst: A three-round burst from a modern firearm, fast tight shots with a short echo, no other sounds
firearm-auto: A long burst of full-automatic gunfire from a modern firearm, about ten fast shots, short echo, no other sounds
heavy-single: A single heavy-calibre gunshot, deep booming report with a long rolling echo, no other sounds
heavy-burst: A short burst of three heavy machine gun rounds, deep powerful thumps with echo, no other sounds
heavy-auto: A sustained burst from a heavy machine gun, deep rapid thudding fire with heavy echo, no other sounds
pistol-single: A single small pistol shot, light snappy crack, short echo, no other sounds
heavypistol-single: A single powerful heavy pistol shot, loud punchy bang with a short echo, no other sounds
smg-single: A single shot from a submachine gun, quick light crack with mechanical clatter, no other sounds
smg-burst: A fast three-round burst from a submachine gun, light rapid cracks with mechanical clatter, no other sounds
smg-auto: A long fast burst of full-automatic submachine gun fire, light rapid rattling shots, no other sounds
shotgun-single: A single pump shotgun blast, loud deep boom followed by a pump-action rack, no other sounds
rifle-single: A single assault rifle shot, sharp loud crack with a rolling outdoor echo, no other sounds
rifle-burst: A three-round burst from an assault rifle, sharp loud cracks with outdoor echo, no other sounds
rifle-auto: A long burst of full-automatic assault rifle fire, loud sharp rapid cracks with echo, no other sounds
sniper-single: A single high-powered sniper rifle shot, huge sharp crack and a long distant echo rolling away, no other sounds
taser-single: A taser firing: a pop, then a crackling electric buzz for a second, no other sounds
mg-auto: A sustained burst from a belt-fed machine gun, steady rapid heavy fire with shell casings tinkling, no other sounds
cannon-single: A single assault cannon shot, a massive deep boom with a shockwave and long echo, no other sounds
launcher-single: A rocket launching from a shoulder launcher: a hollow thump and a roaring whoosh flying away, no other sounds
melee: A blade or club swing whooshing through the air and striking hard with a meaty impact, no other sounds
unarmed: A hard punch landing on a body, a solid fleshy thud with a grunt, no other sounds
bow: A bow string releasing an arrow, a taut twang and a fast whistling arrow, no other sounds
crossbow: A crossbow firing: a mechanical clack and a heavy bolt whipping through the air, no other sounds
thrown: An object thrown hard, a quick whoosh through the air, no impact, no other sounds
blast: A grenade explosion, a loud sharp blast with debris raining down and a rolling echo, no other sounds
smoke: A smoke grenade popping and hissing as thick smoke pours out, no explosion, no other sounds
spell-combat: A magical attack spell: a crackling surge of raw mystical energy building and striking with a deep impact, fantasy, no voice
spell-detection: A detection spell: a soft resonant shimmering chime that spreads outward like sonar, mystical and quiet, no voice
spell-health: A healing spell: a warm gentle swelling hum with soft glittering tones, soothing and magical, no voice
spell-illusion: An illusion spell: a wavering dreamy shimmer with ghostly reversed tones, disorienting and magical, no voice
spell-manipulation: A manipulation spell: a deep thrumming magical force bending the air with a heavy resonant pulse, no voice
reload: Reloading a modern firearm: magazine ejected, a fresh magazine slapped in, and the slide racked, no other sounds
dry-fire: An empty gun dry-firing: a single hollow metallic click of the trigger and hammer, no shot, no other sounds
